policies.title: Remote Work Policy
policies.summary: Guidelines for remote and hybrid work arrangements, including eligibility, equipment, and expectations
keyPoints: All employees eligible for up to 3 days remote work per week
Manager approval required for fully remote arrangements
Company provides laptop, monitor, and €500 home office stipend
Core collaboration hours: 10:00-15:00 local time
Quarterly in-person team meetings required

faqs.question: Can I work from a different country?
faqs.answer: International remote work up to 30 days per year is permitted with manager and HR approval. Tax implications may apply.

faqs.question: What internet speed is required?
faqs.answer: Minimum 50 Mbps download speed is recommended for video conferencing.

faqs.question: How do I request a home office stipend?
faqs.answer: Submit a request through the HR portal under 'Benefits > Home Office Allowance' with receipts.

policies.title: Annual Leave Policy
policies.summary: Annual leave entitlements, booking procedures, and carryover rules
keyPoints: Base entitlement: 25 days per year (pro-rated for part-time)
Additional days for tenure: +1 day after 5 years, +2 days after 10 years
Maximum carryover: 5 days to following year
Minimum 2 weeks notice for leave >5 consecutive days
Manager approval required; automatic approval for <3 days if no conflicts

faqs.question: Can I sell unused leave?
faqs.answer: Up to 3 days can be sold back at the end of the year at base salary rate.

faqs.question: What about bank holidays?
faqs.answer: Bank holidays are in addition to annual leave, following local country calendars.

policies.title: Parental Leave Policy
policies.summary: Comprehensive parental leave for birth, adoption, and surrogacy
keyPoints: Primary caregiver: 26 weeks at full pay
Secondary caregiver: 8 weeks at full pay
Adoption and surrogacy: Same entitlements as birth parents
Flexible return options: part-time for up to 6 months after leave
Keep-in-touch days: up to 10 paid days during leave

faqs.question: When should I notify HR?
faqs.answer: At least 8 weeks before intended leave start date.

faqs.question: Can I split parental leave?
faqs.answer: Yes, leave can be taken in up to 3 blocks within the first 18 months.

policies.title: Learning & Development Policy
policies.summary: Guidelines for professional development, training budgets, and certification support
keyPoints: Annual learning budget: €2,500 per employee
Certification exam fees: 100% reimbursed for first attempt, 50% for retakes
Study leave: 2 days per certification exam
Conference attendance: 1 per year with manager approval
Internal mentoring program available to all

faqs.question: What certifications are eligible?
faqs.answer: Any job-relevant certifications from recognized vendors (AWS, Microsoft, Google, etc.).

faqs.question: Can I use budget for degree programs?
faqs.answer: Executive approval required for degree programs. Separate education assistance policy applies.

policies.title: Performance Management Policy
policies.summary: Continuous feedback culture with quarterly check-ins and annual reviews
keyPoints: Quarterly performance conversations required
Goal setting: OKRs aligned to company objectives
360-degree feedback every 6 months
Performance ratings: Exceptional, Strong, Developing, Below Expectations
Calibration sessions at department level

faqs.question: How are ratings calibrated?
faqs.answer: Department-level calibration sessions ensure consistency. Final ratings approved by HR.

faqs.question: What happens with a 'Below Expectations' rating?
faqs.answer: Performance improvement plan (PIP) initiated with clear goals and 90-day timeline.

policies.title: Information Security Policy
policies.summary: Corporate information security standards and employee responsibilities
keyPoints: All devices must have endpoint protection and disk encryption
MFA required for all corporate applications
Password policy: 14+ characters, 90-day rotation, no reuse of last 12
Data classification: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted
Phishing simulations conducted monthly

faqs.question: Can I use personal devices for work?
faqs.answer: BYOD is permitted with MDM enrollment. Contact IT Security for setup.

faqs.question: How do I report a security incident?
faqs.answer: Email security@company.com or call the 24/7 security hotline immediately.

policies.title: Travel & Expense Policy
policies.summary: Guidelines for business travel and expense reimbursement
keyPoints: Book travel 14+ days in advance when possible
Economy class for flights under 6 hours; business class for longer flights with VP approval
Per diem rates by country (see appendix)
Expense reports due within 30 days
Receipts required for expenses over €25

faqs.question: What's the hotel rate limit?
faqs.answer: Up to €200/night in major cities, €150/night elsewhere. Exceptions require manager approval.

faqs.question: Can I keep frequent flyer miles?
faqs.answer: Yes, personal retention of loyalty points is permitted.
